payload.name: Extract distinct facts alongside relative time expressions
payload.description: When a message contains a relative time expression plus other factual claims such as counts, attendance, or outcomes, extract each distinct fact as its own memory candidate during construction.
content: During extraction, treat each message as a bundle of distinct factual claims: numeric quantities, event details, stated preferences, and relative time expressions each belong in their own candidate.

When a message mixes a relative time expression with another fact (e.g., '7 people attended' and 'want to do it again next month'), resolve the time expression for the relevant candidate and still create a separate candidate for the other fact.
Do not let applying a time-resolution skill suppress extraction of the remaining substantive facts in the same message.
Stop after each distinct fact is captured once; do not add extra candidates for paraphrases or inferred details.

solves: Construction sometimes only resolves a relative time expression and fails to extract other explicit facts in the same message (e.g., attendance counts, outcomes). This skill ensures each distinct claim in a message becomes its own memory candidate.
